selection_method.rule: Ten preselected agentic repositories; take the 20 most recently updated PR search hits with an approved review per repository; use the latest retrievable APPROVED review bound to commit_id; compare that commit_id with the PR final/current head SHA.
limitations: Purposive benchmark corpus, not a random sample.
Repository list was preselected for agentic relevance.
GitHub search indexing and review retrieval can disagree; such records are reported, not silently treated as valid.
HEAD_CHANGED_AFTER_LATEST_APPROVAL proves a later PR-head commit relative to the latest captured approval; it does not prove unsafe execution, merge-policy failure, or vulnerability.
selection_method.replacement_rule: If a selected search hit has no retrievable APPROVED review bound to commit_id, record the rejection and take the next ranked valid hit from the same repository.

truth_boundary: Public GitHub metadata only. This corpus measures approval-to-final-head continuity. It does not claim vulnerability, exploitability, policy violation, or that a post-approval commit bypassed upstream controls.
